judged_text: The PUT /admin/customize/embedding endpoint persists nothing — update just re-renders the serialized embedding — and its only client caller, saveChanges in admin-embedding.js.es6, is never invoked by any template in this diff. Ships an inert staff-writable endpoint plus dead client action and OpenStruct aggregate ('embedding' wrapper) that adds three files of surface for zero behavior; a future maintainer must reason about (or secure) an endpoint that does nothing — the hosts CRUD alone already fully serves the stated requirement.

adjudication.rationale: Diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` only `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and does not persist anything (no param handling, no save). The Ember controller defines `actions.saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, but the only new template `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never invokes `saveChanges` (it only renders hosts table and an `addHost` button). This creates an extra staff-only PUT endpoint (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and client action/adapter/route/controller around an OpenStruct wrapper that currently has no effect beyond re-rendering.
